test_title: PYST 6: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 27 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

They will meet Freddy outside the airport.

options.text: Freddy would have been met outside the airport.
They would be met by Freddy outside the airport.
Freddy will meet them outside the airport.
Freddy will be met by them outside the airport.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Freddy will be met by them outside the airport.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **Future simple tense.**
 
• The simple future tense in the passive voice</strong&
